summary: Warnings for Abiraterone Acetate include monitoring individuals with cardiovascular disease, managing high blood pressure (hypertension), and correcting low potassium levels (hypokalemia) prior to treatment [3]. Monthly checks are required to watch for high blood pressure, fluid buildup, and potassium levels, as well as symptoms of adrenocortical insufficiency, which is low hormone production from the adrenal glands [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a medium score of 58 for the liver and a low score of 39 for the heart [M].
